newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 5.8 points to 745.2 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 5.8 points to 745.2 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose 5.8 points on Thursday to 745.2 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices rose, with the investment fund index rising the most, up 47.8 points to 1,116.
Five indices lost, with the construction index losing the most, down 11.1 points to 860.
